title: Secret Handling Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the secret management policy for a project. Enforces: no env vars in production for sensitive secrets, rotation schedules defined, no plaintext secrets in logs, consumers scoped to minimum access, staging/prod secret separation, and no hardcoded values.

error_codes.SH001: secret-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: secrets[], storage, rotation
error_codes.SH002: Production secret stored in environment variable — use a secret manager (Vault, AWS SSM, GCP Secret Manager)
error_codes.SH003: Secret has no rotation schedule defined — all secrets must declare rotationDays
error_codes.SH004: Secret value may appear in logs — ensure secrets are masked in all log outputs
error_codes.SH005: Secret consumer has access to more secrets than it needs — scope each service to its minimum required secrets
error_codes.SH006: Staging and production share the same secret — environments must use separate secret values
error_codes.SH007: Hardcoded secret value found in spec — reference secrets by name only, never embed values
